theTwentyTwoPrintedTitles.theStructureThisExposes: Nine ACIC reliefs are held as complete petition-and-order pairs. Exactly three halves are missing from the mounted corpus, and they are exactly this lane's three absence items: the Act 346 first-offenders PETITION, the Act 1460 misdemeanors PETITION, and the veterans treatment specialty court ORDER. routeSplitRecommendation.recommendation: SPLIT INTO TWO FAMILIES. Do not choose between the candidates and do not carry both pairs in one family.

whatDistinguishesTheTwoFaces.readFrom: paragraph 2 of all four documents, which is where ACIC puts the adjudication posture
whatDistinguishesTheTwoFaces.preAdjudication: "With the Defendant's consent and without entering a judgment of guilt, the Court deferred further proceedings and placed the Defendant on probation/court supervision." No judgment of guilt was ever entered. Paragraph 3 then requires successful completion of an approved drug court program and paragraph 4 records the completion date.
whatDistinguishesTheTwoFaces.postAdjudication: "The defendant plead guilty or nolo contendere to or was found guilty of ______, in violation of A.C.A. § ______, on the ____ day of ____." A judgment WAS entered. A separate numbered paragraph then records "The Defendant was placed on probation for a period of ______ months", which the pre-adjudication forms do not have because there was no sentence to probate.
whatDistinguishesTheTwoFaces.bothCiteTheSameStatute: A.C.A. § 16-98-303 appears in the caption of all four. The statute does not distinguish them; the recited fact pattern does.

routeSplitRecommendation.whyThisIsNotCosmetic: These are not two layouts of one form. Each petition is a verified filing that asserts a fact about the participant's own case, and the two assertions are mutually exclusive. A post-adjudication participant handed the pre-adjudication petition would file a document swearing that no judgment of guilt was entered, when one was. A pre-adjudication participant handed the post-adjudication petition would file one swearing they pled guilty or were found guilty, when they were not. Either is a false statement in a verified pleading, made by the participant, over their signature. That is the harm the split prevents, and it is why no lane should resolve this by picking the more common branch.

theSplitAsThisLaneWouldWriteIt.relief: Dismissal and sealing of an offence resolved in a PRE-adjudication drug court proceeding under A.C.A. § 16-98-303, where the court deferred further proceedings without entering a judgment of guilt.

Dismissal and sealing of an offence resolved in a POST-adjudication drug court proceeding under A.C.A. § 16-98-303, where the defendant pled guilty or nolo contendere or was found guilty and was then placed on probation conditioned on completing drug court.

routeSplitRecommendation.theScreeningQuestionThatSelectsTheBranch: When your drug court case ended, had you already pleaded guilty or been found guilty, or had the court put the case on hold without entering a finding of guilt? Confirming that four drug-court documents are held and correctly identified says nothing about whether ar-drug-court-set may sell anything. Commercial authority comes from a Grade-A fulfillment record keyed to an exact route and packet family, and from nothing else.
The route-split recommendation is evidence for a determination by the census owner and state counsel. It is not the determination, and no route was changed.

The inference that 3-Misdemeanor-Petition-8_01_2023.pdf is the Act 1460 misdemeanor petition is an inference from inventory metadata and residual assignment. It is not a read, it binds nothing, and it must not be promoted without opening the file.

Legal sufficiency of any packet, and whether a family's named form set is the right form set, are outside this lane. Only what the paper prints, and what the committed records do and do not contain, was established.
